name: Process Street
description: Ask questions about your workflows, runs, tasks, users, and data sets, and take action on them safely. You can retrieve workflow details, inspect run history, check task status, update form fields, trigger new runs, and complete tasks. This provides real operational context and a controllable, auditable way to work inside your existing processes, making it easier for teams to get answers and take action directly within Process Street.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Process Street to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Process Street to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.process.st/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Process Street MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Process Street lists 32 MCP tools, including assignTask, assignWorkflowRun, createDataSetRecord, createWorkflowRun, deleteDataSetRecord, deleteWorkflowRun, getDataSetRecord, getTask, getWorkflowRun, listApprovals, listDataSetRecords, and listDataSets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Process Street?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Process Street in automation-workflows on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sidewave Maggiordomo, Corsair Cloud, Fleet Workspace, Whalesync, and typenode-mcp.

_published_faq.name: Does Process Street MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Process Street requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Process Street is developed by Process Street. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
